e7a2ec8ed3.q: What are the main strategies to recalibrate your business schedule after a busy start to the year?
e7a2ec8ed3.a: Reflect and assess your priorities by reviewing how you spend your time and what's working. Reset your daily and weekly routine by establishing structured work hours and blocking off personal time to recharge. Streamline and delegate by automating repetitive tasks and mastering delegation skills. Use time blocking and batching to group similar tasks together and improve efficiency. Implement time management techniques like the Pomodoro technique and limit distractions from multitasking.

2bc84d8d0e.q: How should high-achieving women approach time management based on their personal productivity patterns?
2bc84d8d0e.a: Rather than following a one-size-fits-all approach, women should understand their own zone of productivity tendencies and customize a time management plan that uses their strengths. Some people work better on harder tasks earlier in the day, others later. Building self-awareness around when you do your best work and in what scenarios allows you to replicate those conditions rather than judging yourself for not fitting standard productivity advice.
